name: guatemala-payroll
description: Use this Guatemala reference for running payroll in tax year 2026, the employer's ISR withholding on rentas del trabajo, the statutory bonuses and the 2026 minimum wages. Match requests such as Guatemala payroll, nómina Guatemala, retención ISR asalariados, proyección de renta, Retenciones WEB, SAT-1331, constancia de retención, Q51,024 deducción 2026, aguinaldo, Bono 14, bonificación incentivo Q250, salario mínimo 2026, horas extra, vacaciones, indemnización, gross to net Guatemala, non-resident salary 15%, and employer cost Guatemala. It gives the projection method of Decreto 10-2012 articles 75 to 80, the 2026 deduction, the Acuerdo Gubernativo 256-2025 wages, the Código de Trabajo hours and premiums, and links IGSS, INTECAP and IRTRA to guatemala-social-contributions. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
